title: Units Carried Over on a Prior Authorization Provider Change
content:
**Units ledger standard — Prior Authorization, units carried over to a new servicing provider**

**Definition.** The units a provider change carries over are the units left on the approval (the units granted less the units posted as used and less any units released), limited to the units the new provider can deliver before the end date, which are the whole weeks from the day of the change to the end date (the days between them divided by seven and rounded down) multiplied by the class's weekly frequency cap. The units carried over are the smaller of those two figures, in whole units, and are never below zero.

**The two figures.**

1. *Units left on the approval* — every unit granted on the Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization approval, less every unit posted as used on it, less every unit already released from it; a result below zero counts as zero.
2. *Units the new provider can deliver before the end date* — the number of days from the day of the change to the end date (the end date less the day of the change, so a change ten days before the end date counts 10 days), divided by seven and rounded down to whole weeks, multiplied by the class's weekly frequency cap, which is the most units that may be used in one Monday-Sunday week in that authorization class.

**Result.** The smaller of figure 1 and figure 2.

### Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, for illustration only)

| Input | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Units granted | 12 | 12 |
| Units posted as used | 2 | 8 |
| Units released | 0 | 0 |
| Units left on the approval | 10 | 4 |
| Days from the change to the end date | 20 | 30 |
| Whole weeks (days divided by seven, rounded down) | 2 | 4 |
| Weekly frequency cap of the class (hypothetical) | 3 | 3 |
| Units deliverable before the end date | 6 | 12 |
| **Units carried over (the smaller)** | **6** | **4** |

In case A the new provider's delivery before the end date is the limit; in case B the units left on the approval are.
